sections.title_hint: The Map: What This Sector Is
required: value chain and where the profit pools sit
the 12-point frame applied: economics, moats, cyclicality, regulation
bottoms-up sizing with arithmetic shown; tops-down cited only as cross-check
growth decomposition: price vs volume vs share
cohort table across the tracked companies with tiered figures
capital efficiency and quality ranking (per-point expression only)
